prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need. 

If you want a quick starting point:
- Barkley — KC‑based, full‑service creative and brand agency known for big integrated campaigns.
- VML (now part of VMLY&R) — global digital and experience agency that started in KC; strong on digital strategy, CX and large brand work.

How I can help next (pick one):
- Recommend a short list of KC agencies tailored to your needs (SEO, PPC, branding, B2B, startups, enterprise, etc.).
- Compare 3–5 agencies on pricing, specialties and recent case studies.
- Give a checklist and interview questions so you can evaluate agencies yourself.

Tell me: what kind of business are you, what are your marketing goals, and what’s your approximate budget? I’ll put together a targeted shortlist.
